nativeTextExtraction.method: Final Office/Oficina plate only. Native PDF reading order displaces first letters in two names and duplicates overlapping glyphs in another; visible names are corroborated by correctly ordered fusion cells in the same office and exact current county roster.

partyTypography.basis: The same sample row heading and current county roster say Vote Affordable. Exact printed cell labels are retained in source quotes; no candidate identity is inferred from party.

lookupApplicability: Some street/precinct link labels do not agree with the downloaded PDF jurisdiction panel. Printed PDF scope governs. No claim of address-to-ballot-style completeness; the unnumbered Ardsley PDF is joined to exact Ardsley office rows in two current county publications.
